# @buildanagent/cli

> The buildanagent command line: runs the harness in a terminal.

The sections of README.md and every public export, generated from this package's README and declaration files in the same commit as its code.

## Exports from `@buildanagent/cli`

- `class CliError`: Thrown for a command the CLI can't run as given.
- `type CliErrorCode`: Why a `CliError` was thrown.
- `interface CliIo`: The terminal a command talks to.
- `interface CliOptions`: The options of `runCli()`.
- `interface CliStreams`: The standard streams as bytes, which `rpc` serves the protocol over.
- `HELP`: The help `--help` prints.
- `interface HostRules`: The permission rules a host adds to the harness's default ask rules.
- `isCliError()`: True for a `CliError`, including one from another copy of the package.
- `linesOf()`: Splits a stream of text or bytes into lines at `\n`, dropping a `\r` before it.
- `PACKAGE_NAME`: The package's npm name, `@buildanagent/cli`.
- `runCli()`: Runs the `buildanagent` command line `argv`, the arguments after the program's name, and resolves with the exit status.
